# Tad Oliphant Construction LLC

> Oregon Coast general contractor based in Siletz, OR. A+ BBB rated. Specializing in decks, siding, roofing, remodeling, windows & doors, dry-rot repair, painting, and fencing. Serving Lincoln County since 2015. CCB #206723. Owner Tad Oliphant is on every job.

## Services
- [Deck Construction](https://tadoliphantconstruction.com/services/deck-construction.html): New composite and wood decks built for coastal weather
- [Deck Repair](https://tadoliphantconstruction.com/services/deck-repair.html): Structural repair, board replacement, railing fixes
- [Siding & Exterior](https://tadoliphantconstruction.com/services/siding-repair.html): Siding replacement and exterior damage restoration
- [Dry-Rot Repair](https://tadoliphantconstruction.com/services/dry-rot-repair.html): Detection and repair of hidden rot damage
- [Roofing](https://tadoliphantconstruction.com/services/roofing.html): Roof replacement and repair for coastal homes
- [Windows & Doors](https://tadoliphantconstruction.com/services/windows-doors.html): Replacement windows, doors, and framing
- [Home Remodeling](https://tadoliphantconstruction.com/services/home-remodeling.html): Kitchen, bathroom, and whole-home renovations
- [Painting](https://tadoliphantconstruction.com/services/painting.html): Interior and exterior painting
- [Fencing](https://tadoliphantconstruction.com/services/fencing.html): Fences, windbreaks, and custom carpentry
